label: sdc02_0300_sister_01
text: That was Terapagos? You...caught it, right?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0300_bbteacher_02
text: The fact that you brought along a Master Ball\ntells me you were well prepared for this![VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0300_bbteacher_03
text: Now I can study Terapagos whenever I want...\nBut! There’s no time like the present![VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0300_bbteacher_04
text: Think you could give us a little demonstration of\nTerapagos’s power right now?[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc02_0300_brother_03
text: I’m also itching to see what Terapagos can do.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc02_0300_brother_04
text: Get ready so we can start.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc02_0300_sister_npc
text: Are...are you sure it’s safe to battle with a\nPokémon we barely know anything about...?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0300_bbteacher_npc
text: Ooh, I can hardly contain myself! I simply MUST\nsee Terapagos’s power right away![VAR 0x0114(0042)]
